description:
Outcome: Checkpoint: first-version acceptance; source: brief.md First version 1-4; conversation latest map deferral.
Scope: Criteria: accept brief features 1-4 plus passwordless sign-in and daily email. Artifact: release candidate and coverage evidence.
Excludes: online payments and tool lending; plot map excluded from first version and retained only in T-018.
Acceptance: Explicit owner acceptance or requested changes; map, payments and tool lending outside first-version acceptance.
Behaviour: Passing automated tests do not imply owner acceptance; ordinary ticket has no technical approval gate.
Verification: Owner walkthrough of first-version acceptance checklist.
Prerequisites: T-016.
Assumptions: Approved setup assumptions: one household account; coordinator configures local timezone/application window; default occupancy March 1-October 31; returning means immediately prior season; initial final allocation after February 1 cutoff, advisory preferences and application order within groups; FIFO waiting list; no same-season reapplication after withdrawal/release; active holdings unique, history preserved; own active-plot reporting with coordinator-only report access; daily digest defaults to 08:00 local and skips empty days. No existing implementation. T-003 reviews provisional domain rules.
title: Checkpoint: first-version acceptance
